info.prompt: Neon-noir vignette of a high-stakes Banking Decision—the player’s clawed cybernetic hand hovering over the BANK button as their unbanked 15,000 points flicker in emerald PDX digits above the grid, the board itself a minefield of risky two-threes-four combinations and one shimmering Wild Blocker "W", all viewed through a cracked HUD lens displaying real-time Farkle probability algorithms (82%) and teammate Rally votes (3x CONTINUE pulsing in bio-luminescent cyan).
